capability: SC Labs multistate COA rule-version pre-release validator: reads CSV or JSON; joins sample, jurisdiction, license, matrix, custody, rule pack, requested panel, method/LOQ, accreditation, signer, and final COA evidence; writes deterministic RELEASEABLE/HOLD CSV and JSON, a human exception report, and a hash-linked append-only manifest. The locked fixture has 150 records across five rule packs, exactly 120 RELEASEABLE and 30 HOLD in six five-record reason families. It alters no result and executes no override or COA release.
name: SC Labs multistate COA rule-version gate
next_gap: Next production input: buyer-owned export schemas and approved rule-pack files. This synthetic validator makes no regulatory or release assertion.
